attempts.summary: Set up PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2, and node3 (standbys) on Alpine Linux. Demonstrated a full failover: killed node1 (primary), promoted node2 to writable primary with zero committed-data loss, repointed node3 to follow node2, then rebuilt node1 as a standby of node2 via pg_basebackup once pg_rewind proved infeasible (source WAL segment already recycled). Final topology: node2 primary, node1 and node3 standbys, fully streaming and consistent. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: restarted node1, node3, then node2 (the primary) one at a time via native reboot, confirming a changed OS boot_id and full PostgreSQL/data/replication recovery after each restart, preserving write availability throughout.
